capabilities: Add time estimates to tasks with quick-entry symbols like +, @, $ and !
Total estimated hours by day range in a sidebar folder dashboard
Run Tasks-style query blocks with extra estimate instructions
Start and stop a timer that records actual time spent on a task
Edit dates, estimates and checkboxes directly in dashboards and query results
extras: README states the plugin works entirely offline and makes no network requests; Japanese documentation is available via a linked page.
intentEvidence: It uses the same format as the Tasks plugin, so the two work together (Tasks isn't required).
problem: Obsidian tasks have no built-in way to record time estimates or see how many estimated hours are scheduled for coming days.

relations.evidence: It uses the same format as the Tasks plugin, so the two work together (Tasks isn't required).

summary: Task time-estimating plugin that adds ⏱️ estimates via quick-entry symbols, totals hours by date in a sidebar dashboard, and times actual work.
